"Oh," replied Ned, "I do that so as to be ready to catch any choice scenes I come across; I'm making a collection of views, you know, and I expect to get a good many on this trip. By the way, I got some stunning views over there at your place this morning, just before breakfast."

54066-the-younger-sister-a-novel-volumes.creator: Unknown

The only one of the family who could be said to have received a good education, was the youngest daughter, Emma—who, on her mother's death, was begged of her father by his brother-in-law, and brought up by him and his wife, as tenderly as if she had been their own.

arxiv-2104-13464.title: Deep Two-Stage High-Resolution Image Inpainting
arxiv-2104-13464.creator: Andrey Moskalenko, Mikhail Erofeev, Dmitriy Vatolin
arxiv-2104-13464.description: Abstract In recent years, the field of image inpainting has developed rapidly, learning based approaches show impressive results in the task of filling missing parts in an image. But most deep methods are strongly tied to the resolution of the images on which they were trained. A slight resolution increase leads to serious artifacts and unsatisfactory filling quality.

arxiv-2211-02034.title: Convergence of the logarithm of the characteristic polynomial of unitary Brownian motion in Sobolev space
arxiv-2211-02034.creator: Johannes Forkel, Isao Sauzedde
arxiv-2211-02034.description: Abstract We prove that the convergence of the real and imaginary parts of the logarithm of the characteristic polynomial of unitary Brownian motion toward Gaussian free fields on the cylinder, as the matrix dimension goes to infinity, holds in certain suitable Sobolev spaces, which we believe to be optimal.

arxiv-2408-01277.title: Two Generalizations of Hopfian Abelian Groups
arxiv-2408-01277.creator: Andrey R. Chekhlov, Peter V. Danchev, Brendan Goldsmith, Patrick W. Keef
arxiv-2408-01277.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andrey R. Chekhlov, Peter V. Danchev, Brendan Goldsmith, Patrick W. Keef. This paper targets to generalize the notion of Hopfian groups in the commutative case by defining the so-called relatively Hopfian groups and weakly Hopfian groups , and establishing some their crucial properties and characterizations. Specifically, we prove that for a reduced Abelian p p -group G G such that p ω ​ G p^{\omega}G is Hopfian (in particular, is finite), the notions of relative Hopficity and ordinary Hopficity do coincide.

arxiv-2503-09819.title: Attention Reveals More Than Tokens: Training-Free Long-Context Reasoning with Attention-guided Retrieval
arxiv-2503-09819.creator: Yuwei Zhang, Jayanth Srinivasa, Gaowen Liu, Jingbo Shang, University of California, San Diego, Cisco
arxiv-2503-09819.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit substantially shorter effective context lengths than their claimed capacities, especially when handling complex reasoning tasks that require integrating information from multiple parts of a long context and performing multi-step reasoning. Although Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has shown promise in reducing task complexity, our empirical analysis reveals that it does not fully resolve this limitation.

arxiv-2506-12850.title: Journey of Lars Ahlfors’ Fields Medal
arxiv-2506-12850.creator: Frank Wang, fwang@lagcc.cuny.edu
arxiv-2506-12850.description: Abstract ﻿ Lars Ahlfors was born in Finland in 1907. In 1936, he received, along with Jesse Douglas, one of the first two Fields Medals. At the time, he was a professor at the University of Helsinki, and a visiting professor, from 1935 to 1938, at Harvard University.

arxiv-2509-17674.title: Predicting Chest Radiograph Findings from Electrocardiograms Using Interpretable Machine Learning
arxiv-2509-17674.creator: Julia Matejas, Olaf Żurawski, Nils Strodthoff, Juan Miguel Lopez Alcaraz
arxiv-2509-17674.description: Abstract Purpose: Chest X-rays are essential for diagnosing pulmonary conditions, but limited access in resource-constrained settings can delay timely diagnosis. Electrocardiograms (ECGs), in contrast, are widely available, non-invasive, and often acquired earlier in clinical workflows. This study aims to assess whether ECG features and patient demographics can predict chest radiograph findings using an interpretable machine learning approach.

pmc-11570972.title: Locoregional recurrence after neoadjuvant versus adjuvant chemotherapy based on tumor subtypes in patients with early-stage breast cancer: A multi-institutional retrospective cohort study
pmc-11570972.creator: Jong-Ho Cheun, Youngji Kwak, Eunhye Kang, Ji-Jung Jung, Hong-Kyu Kim, Han-Byoel Lee, Kyung-Hun Lee, Hyeong-Gon Moon, Ki-Tae Hwang, Yeon Hee Park, Jeong Eon Lee, Wonshik Han
pmc-11570972.description: BackgroundNeoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) for early-stage breast cancer is associated with an increased risk of locoregional recurrence (LRR). We investigated whether the risk of LRR after NACT varies across tumor subtypes.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed the medical records of women who underwent breast-conserving surgery for breast cancer at three institutions between January 1, 2004, and December 31, 2018.

pmc-12412136.title: Social origin and the intention to enrol in higher education: personality traits as a mechanism of reproduction or mobility?
pmc-12412136.creator: David Nika, Michael Grüttner, Sandra Buchholz
pmc-12412136.description: A vast amount of research has shown that social inequality in educational attainment is a persistent phenomenon. Sociological research explains unequal educational decisions via primary and secondary effects of social origin, respectively unequal school performance and patterns of educational decision-making. So far, educational sociology has largely ignored the role of personality traits for educational decision-making.

pmc-12565915.title: Clinical Characteristics and the Prognostic Factors of Acute Peripheral Facial Palsy in Children
pmc-12565915.creator: Young-Soo Chang, Su Jeong You
pmc-12565915.description: Background and Objectives: This study aimed to investigate the clinical characteristics of children with acute peripheral facial palsy (PFP) in a single medical center. Materials and Methods: We conducted a retrospective analysis of children under 19 years of age treated for acute PFP between January 2009 and July 2023.

pmc-12764240.title: The Effects of Obesity on Lung Physiology, the Prevalence and Severity of Chronic Pulmonary Diseases, and Inhalation Treatment
pmc-12764240.creator: Eleonore Fröhlich
pmc-12764240.description: Obesity itself induces macroscopic, microscopic, and functional changes in the lungs, potentially making obese individuals more susceptible to acute and chronic pulmonary diseases. Apart from direct contribution to the course of the disease, obesity-induced alterations of the respiratory tract may influence the delivery and efficacy of inhaled formulations.

pmc-13173144.title: 165 Assessing and monitoring mentor-mentee relationships: The Colorado Clinical and Translational and Sciences Institute (CCTSI) approach
pmc-13173144.creator: Lisa Cicutto, Ellen Burnham, Goldie Komaie, Lauren Shomaker
pmc-13173144.description: Objectives/Goals: To develop a tool to assess mentoring relationships (mentor-mentee dyad) that can be used to monitor relationships over time to identify those at-risk along with knowledge and skills gaps for targeted coaching and career development initiatives and to evaluate mentoring programs.

pmc-13254410.title: Quantitative stable isotope probing (qSIP)-informed metagenomics identifies viruses infecting chemoautotrophs
pmc-13254410.creator: Elaine Luo, Ngoc D Pham, Timothy J Rogers, Md Moinuddin Sheam, Bayleigh E Benner, Joseph J Vallino, Gareth Trubl, Julie A Huber
pmc-13254410.description: Aquatic environments absorb ~2.5 gigatonnes of atmospheric carbon each year1, more than the carbon stored in the atmosphere, soils, and all biomass combined. Primary producers transform this dissolved inorganic carbon into biomass that can subsequently flow into other trophic levels, or be released back into the environment through viral lysis.

pmc-13273978.title: Impact of whole-herd vaccination on a caprine coxiellosis outbreak: a longitudinal study of Coxiella burnetii shedding, serology, and host microbiota
pmc-13273978.creator: Raquel Toledo-Perona, Jesús Gomis, Nerea Bailon-Larrañaga, Antonio Contreras, Juan José Quereda, Pedro González-Torres, Nerea Carrón, Ángel Gómez-Martín
pmc-13273978.description: This longitudinal study investigated C. burnetii dynamics and the associated microbiota after vaccination in aborted and normal-delivery goats and bucks following a Q fever outbreak. Fecal, milk, vaginal, preputial, nasopharyngeal, environmental (qPCR and 16S rRNA), and blood samples (16S rRNA and serology) were analyzed.

pmc-13326517.title: Barley HvBODYGUARD1 controls cuticular specialisations regulated by SHINE transcription factors
pmc-13326517.creator: Trisha McAllister, Chiara Campoli, Linsan Liu, Tansy Chia, S Ronan Fisher, Richard Horsnell, Alan R Prescott, Jennifer Shoesmith, Mhmoud Eskan, Alasdair Iredale, Mirjam Nuter, Luke Ramsay, Micha M Bayer, Linda Milne, Miriam Schreiber, Yogeswari Rajarathinam, Vanessa Wahl, Robbie Waugh, James Cockram
pmc-13326517.description: Summary Land plants secrete a protective outer cuticular layer with diverse functions. Barley (Hordeum vulgare L.) develops two cuticular specialisations: the β‐diketone rich wax bloom on vegetative tissues and an adherent grain surface which sticks to the hulls, leading to barley's distinctive ‘covered’ grain phenotype.

pmc-13369992.title: Performance Studies on machine learning based channel modelling for vehicular visible light communication
pmc-13369992.creator: L Ramya, K Umadevi
pmc-13369992.description: Car headlights and taillights, to provide cost-effective and high-data-rate interference-resilient communication, have spawned Vehicular Visible Light Communication (V2LC), a possible additional technology to radio-frequency systems. Since they can be formulated in an empirical or deterministic way, traditional optical channel models can be easily adapted to changing vehicle environments.

pmc-13520445.title: Novel role of the class II α-isoform of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase in hepatocellular carcinoma: suppressing metastasis by targeting Wnt/β-catenin signaling via inhibiting phosphorylation of LRP6
pmc-13520445.creator: Jing Chen, Li-Xin Ren, Yong Ma, Wen-Hua Cheng, Ting Liu

pmc-13615534.title: Constructing cell-type-specific gene regulatory networks from cell–cell communication and a global gene regulatory network
pmc-13615534.creator: Yuke Xie, Bowen Fu, Laijun Zhong, Lei Wu, Haorong Li, Xiao Chang, Xiaoping Liu
pmc-13615534.description: Accurately inferring cell-type-specific gene regulatory networks (GRNs) is crucial for understanding cellular heterogeneity, lineage determination, and disease progression mechanisms. Although single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables high-resolution expression profiling, its inherent sparsity and high noise levels pose challenges to reliable GRN reconstruction.
